resolved_findings.issue: Derived context/census validation could mask the original ERROR row and discard lower-mode delivery evidence
resolved_findings.resolution: run_arm now writes raw-arm-execution.json immediately after completion.execute/context exit and before every derived gate; includes original row, restore receipt, actual contexts and early candidates/deliveries/order. No tensor dump or relaxed gate.

reviewed_method: Reads original pinned module-hook injector and upper CaptureMode dispatch directly. Late faults arrive after producer record; early lower mode invokes natural addmm once and returns clone-mutated output before upper record. Shared capture recursion flag is intentionally ignored in lower mode; mutation bookkeeping disables modes only after natural op.

Exact region/role/operator/operand schema, output shape/dtype/contiguity/numel, old/new bits and first-occurrence census qualified; no site search or fallback. Fixed flat coordinate shared across deliberate native2D/module3D shapes.

Original intervention class remains unchanged; subclass exposes actual instance/context and removes only late hook installation for early arms. Native clone strategy records version/pointer/view metadata; mathematical derivative independence is not assumed sufficient.

Each full-model arm restores exact complete prestate; accepted early/late and observed/unobserved faults require strict finite byte/value equality of full state, preclip and postclip gradients, including RNG. All eight contexts per region and matched observer populations checked.

Rejecting early enforce must retain same finite preclip gradients and all protected persistent prestate except RNG; no postclip transition reached and no rollback or RNG-restoration claim. Valid nonpredicted checker patterns are retained separately.

Clean early lower mode remains installed with disabled fault/alloutput observation, zero events, finite gradient and complete matching pairs. This is a mode-specific negative control, not an additional independent clean observer endpoint comparison.

Seven allocated definitions cover actual upper CaptureMode ordering, helper-event exclusion, disabled/original behavior, duplicate/missing candidate rejection, wrong bits/shape/schema, tiny cloned-output autograd parity and zero-stride logical byte/source immutability. Actual fixture pass remains required.

Frozen single-device mapping matches old per-worker CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; avoids uncontrolled unused device RNGs in fresh-process baseline. No cross-phase full RNG manifest equivalence to three-visible-device primary is claimed.
